description:
Whether you're riding a homemade ramp or visiting the skatepark for the first time, the Origin 360 offers the performance you need and an amazing price. The Origin 360 offers a lightweight hollow box deck, steel brake, 100 mm high impact wheels, and durable ABEC-7 bearings. Get ready to rip on the Origin 360!
Lightweight hollow box deck for pro-style performance.
Steel brake combine with 100 mm high impact wheels and durable ABEC-7 bearings to provide smooth non-slip riding.
Two-piece welded steel handlebar with rubber grips provide durability and comfort.
Double clamp collar delivers precise steering.
Heavy-duty frame supports riders ages 5 and up, with a maximum weight of 176 lbs.
